title: An exponential equation in one base
source: P23 Ch2 theory P23-2.5 Quick check 1 (2^x=20, x=4.32 to 3 s.f.)
stem: Solve {a|int} to the power x equals {N|int}, giving your answer correct to 3 significant figures.

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: Taking logarithms, x times the logarithm of {a|int} equals the logarithm of {N|int}.
steps.note: Take logs and use the power law.

steps.name: E
steps.text_tex: So x is the logarithm of {N|int} divided by the logarithm of {a|int}, which is {E|sf3z} to 3 significant figures.

contexts.stem: Find x, correct to 3 significant figures, if {a|int} to the power x equals {N|int}.
Solve the exponential equation in which {a|int} to the power x equals {N|int}. Give x to 3 significant figures.

title: An exponential equation with a linear index
source: P23 Ch2 theory P23-2.5 Quick check 2 (5^{2x+1}=12, x=0.272 to 3 s.f.)
stem: Solve {a|int} to the power ({b|int}x+{c|int}) equals {N|int}, giving your answer correct to 3 significant figures.

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: Taking logarithms, ({b|int}x+{c|int}) times the logarithm of {a|int} equals the logarithm of {N|int}.
steps.note: Take logs and expand the index.

Solve the exponential equation {a|int} to the power {b|int}x+{c|int} equals {N|int}, to 3 significant figures.

title: Different bases on each side
source: P23 Ch2 theory P23-2.5 Quick check 3 (3^x=2^{x+2}, x=3.42 to 3 s.f.)
stem: Solve {a|int} to the power x equals {b|int} to the power (x+{c|int}), giving your answer correct to 3 significant figures.

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: Taking logarithms and collecting x terms, x times (the logarithm of {a|int} minus the logarithm of {b|int}) equals {c|int} times the logarithm of {b|int}.

title: 9709/21/O/N/10 Q2: use logarithms to solve 5 to the x equals 2 to the (2x+1)

source.note: Stem verbatim from the QP PDF (the printed equation is 5 to the power x equals 2 to the power (2x+1), confirmed by the official MS). Fully manual, because the official MS allows the interval from 3.10 to 3.11 rather than a single 3 significant figure value; automatic 3 s.f. marking would reject the allowed 3.10. Independently, log 2 divided by (log 5 minus 2 log 2) equals 3.10628..., which rounds to 3.11 to 3 s.f.

stem: Use logarithms to solve the equation \(5^x=2^{2x+1}\), giving your answer correct to 3 significant figures.

steps.name: law
steps.text_tex: Take logarithms of both sides and use the power law.
steps.note: Official MS: M1* use a law for the logarithm of a product, a quotient or a power.

steps.name: eq
steps.text_tex: This gives \(x\log 5=(2x+1)\log 2\), or an equivalent equation.
steps.note: Official MS: A1 obtain x log 5 = (2x+1) log 2, or equivalent.

steps.name: collect
steps.note: Official MS: M1(dep*) solve for x via correct manipulative technique(s). Recorded as M1 because the checker mark field allows M1* / *M1 but not M1(dep*). Official scheme totals [4].

steps.name: E
steps.note: Official MS: A1 obtain x=3.11, allowed in [3.10, 3.11]. Independently 3.10628...
